name: Editor select handlers must not return a value
body:
Dean (2026-11-14): the editor reports error[CHA0561]: the handler in prop 'onSelect' on <select> raised an error: the lambda is declared to return void but returned a value, at Toolbar.chaos:70.

Cause: onSelect and onToggle lambdas that are expression bodies return what they call, and editorCameraPreset and editorSetViewOption return bool. Chaos now refuses a void lambda that returns a value. Fix: call them in a block, `-> { editorCameraPreset(preset); }`, as the other handlers do. Sites: Toolbar.chaos:70, CameraSettings.chaos:19, ViewportSettings.chaos:20, ViewOptionRow.chaos:12, AssetBrowser.chaos:40 (editorAddEntity) and HistoryPanel.chaos:27 (editorJumpHistory).
acceptance_criteria: The camera preset select in the toolbar and settings, and the view option controls, raise no CHA0561.
